content:
Overview

Townsville is a city in Queensland with a population of 180,820. North Queensland’s tropical city with Magnetic Island, the Great Barrier Reef, and a large military presence. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
